description: Paid (tiered: 1h ~$0.50 / 6h ~$2.50 / 24h ~$7.50). Buy a time-boxed WebSocket subscription to live Pulse events. Returns a stream_token JWT and ws_url. Server-side filtering by source, signal, and min USD is bound into the token at purchase.

_bypass_key.description: Operator-issued bypass key. Only useful if the server operator gave you one; ignored unless it matches the server's MCP_BYPASS_KEY. Omit it and pay via payment_signature instead.

min_usd.description: USD floor for whale events. Bound into JWT.

signals.description: Signal allowlist. Omit for all signals.

sources.description: Source allowlist. Omit for all sources.

name: xrpl_pulse_stream_purchase
